handler.command: d="$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf %s "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR")"; f="$d/.claude/hooks/protected-file-guard.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec bash "$f"; fi; if [ -e "$d/.claude/hooks/hooks.env" ] || [ -e "$d/.claude/protected-files.txt" ]; then x=ask; if grep -Eq '"permission_mode"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"(bypassPermissions|dontAsk)"'; then x=deny; fi; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"%s","permissionDecisionReason":"%s"}}\n' "$x" "The protected-file guard script is missing, but this repository still has its hooks configuration, so every edit and command needs your approval until the guard is restored: git checkout -- .claude/hooks, or reinstall from the download."; exit 0; fi; echo "hooks pack: $f is not installed in this folder, so protected-file-guard is off here" >&2

d="$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf %s "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR")"; f="$d/.claude/hooks/commit-check.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec bash "$f"; fi; v="$(grep -E '^COMMIT_CHECK_CMD=' "$d/.claude/hooks/hooks.env" 2>/dev/null | tail -1)"; case "${v#COMMIT_CHECK_CMD=}" in *[![:space:]]*) i="$(cat)"; c="$(printf '%s' "$i" | grep -oE '"command"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"\\]|\\.)*"' | head -1)"; [ -n "$c" ] || c="$i"; if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_.-])git([^A-Za-z0-9_.-].*)?[^A-Za-z0-9_-]commit([^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)'; then x=ask; if printf '%s' "$i" | grep -Eq '"permission_mode"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"(bypassPermissions|dontAsk)"'; then x=deny; fi; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"%s","permissionDecisionReason":"%s"}}\n' "$x" "The commit check script is missing, but this repository's .claude/hooks/hooks.env still sets COMMIT_CHECK_CMD, so the check was NOT run and every commit needs your approval until the script is restored: git checkout -- .claude/hooks, or reinstall from the download."; exit 0; fi ;; esac; echo "hooks pack: $f is not installed in this folder, so commit-check is off here" >&2

d="$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf %s "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR")"; f="$d/.claude/hooks/pending-question-reprint.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec bash "$f"; fi; echo "hooks pack: $f is not installed in this folder, so pending-question-reprint is off here" >&2
